newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said most of the rates had begun to stabilise due to increasing demand for short-term money on the market after they plunged last week due to last month's bank interest rate cut.

"Many non-bank financial institutions which used to be net lenders last week borrowed money on the market in the past few trading days," one trader said. "But state-run banks have still been net lenders."
"The downtrend after the interest rate cut seems over," said a second trader. "Room for further falls is limited with demand increasing partly due to a more active stock market."
